issues.description: ArrayHelpers provides a method to append an element to an array, but its name differs between the template and the rest of the code. In the template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java) the method is declared as appendElement(T[] array, T element) (lines 13-16), whereas both the template Stock.addToStockIngredients implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java, line 19) and the solution implementation expect a method named addElementToArray(T[] array, T element) (solution src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java, lines 13-16). This naming mismatch causes a compile-time error for the provided template (Stock calls a non-existent method) and will block students from running or building the starter project.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the helper method name across artifacts. Preferred fix: rename the template method appendElement(T[] array, T element) to addElementToArray(T[] array, T element) (update its Javadoc/signature and usages). Alternatively, change the call in Stock.addToStockIngredients to use appendElement(...). The first option (aligning the template to addElementToArray) is recommended because it matches the solution and avoids confusing students or requiring changes in multiple files.
